title: a13n Service operations
description: Optional operator dashboard. Process observations for diagnosis, not durable accounting. All queries preserve deployment identity. No samples is not healthy zero. See deploy/monitoring/README.md.

panels.title: Overview — choose one deployment for diagnosis
Scrape targets up / down
panels.description: Discovered targets by role, split into successful and failed scrapes. Not /readyz; targets removed from discovery cannot appear as down.

panels.title: Due run age
panels.description: Oldest due accepted Run; waiting Runs and future backoff are excluded. Stale snapshots are omitted.

panels.title: Worker slots
panels.description: Process-local slots summed across workers. Retained tools and background work may outlive an Attempt slot.

panels.title: Business API 5xx ratio
panels.description: Non-stream API responses only, excluding probes/static content. No requests means no ratio; not zero errors.

targets.expr: (sum by (deployment) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment=~"$deployment",a13n_request_kind="api",http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or on (deployment) (0 * sum by (deployment) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment=~"$deployment",a13n_request_kind="api"}[$__rate_interval])))) / sum by (deployment) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",deployment=~"$deployment",a13n_request_kind="api"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Run throughput
panels.description: Rates are process observations, not exact durable business totals. Accepted and sealed populations are independent.

panels.title: Backlog snapshot age
panels.description: Maximum age across reporters/queues. Above 60s, cached values are excluded below; inspect report_backlog and storage.

panels.title: Ingress — probes and SSE do not dilute business API signals
API responses by status
panels.description: Completed non-stream API responses; 4xx, including 429, are separate from 5xx.

panels.title: API latency p95
panels.description: Ten slowest API route templates per deployment at each evaluation, request through response end. Probes, static responses and SSE excluded; inspect logs for request IDs.

panels.title: SSE response headers p95
panels.description: Request to SSE headers. This is not model TTFT or time to first meaningful output.

panels.title: Probe failures
panels.description: Probe failures stay visible without diluting API success ratios. Scrape success alone does not prove readiness.

panels.title: Waiting and execution — distinguish input, Run and Attempt
Due work count (bounded)
panels.description: Replicated database snapshots use max after filtering stale reporters. Inbox counts only idle/unpaused eligible threads. Scheduled queues are planning and due dispatch, not sleeping schedules.

panels.title: Due work oldest age
panels.description: Waiting age of currently due work, not historical completed latency. A zero means no due work in a fresh snapshot. Inbox age starts at entry creation, including time blocked behind a prior Run, not eligibility time.

panels.title: Count at ceiling
panels.description: 1 means the bounded count is a lower bound, not an exact inventory. 0 means below ceiling.

panels.title: Inbox assignment wait p95
panels.description: Entry creation to each committed assignment, including deliberate blocking behind a prior Run and reassignments. Not time since eligibility; separate from worker claim wait.

panels.title: Due Run claim wait p95
panels.description: available_at to committed worker claim, excluding future retry backoff. Separate from inbox business blocking.

panels.title: Worker claim scans
panels.description: Empty scans are normal. Failed scans with growing queue age suggest storage or claim problems, not lack of capacity.

panels.title: Attempt starts
panels.description: Initial, failure recovery and planned handoff. Rolling deployments may increase handoff without indicating failure.

panels.title: Attempt and Run duration p95
panels.description: Attempt claim-to-end and Run creation-to-seal, each split by terminal status. Waiting ends at the approval pause; its successor is a separate Run. Compare matching outcomes, not mixed populations.

panels.title: Run outcomes
panels.description: Window of seals, not success rate of accepted cohort. waiting/cancelled are not failures.

panels.title: Run failure reasons
panels.description: Failed seal rate by reason. Find Run sealed logs, then attempt traces; no tenant or object identities are metric labels.

panels.title: Attempt endings
panels.description: Shows lease expiry and recovery hidden by a later successful Run. Handoff is planned, not an error.

panels.title: Model token throughput
panels.description: Provider token rate. Cached input is included in input totals; configured model names belong to durable Usage, not global labels.

panels.title: Model first chunk p95
panels.description: Streaming model request to first surfaced chunk, including non-text chunks. Not SSE response headers or guaranteed first meaningful token.

panels.title: Open SSE connections
panels.description: Local active connections summed across processes. A long healthy connection is expected, not a slow API request.

panels.title: SSE close outcomes
panels.description: A response can retain HTTP 200 after output fails. Cancellation can be shutdown/disconnect; inspect alongside drops and gaps.

panels.title: Live output dropped frames
panels.description: Counts output before checkpoint recovery: oversized frames, writer saturation or failed Redis append. Does not imply durable output loss.

panels.title: Reader recovery and overflow
panels.description: Gaps are per reader, not unique missing frames. Slow consumers reconnect from the committed view.

panels.title: Schedule dispositions
panels.description: submitted means input committed, not Run started. Skips include overlap/missed deadlines; manual and scheduled triggers share the disposition counter.

panels.title: Automatic schedule delay p95
panels.description: Scheduled fire to disposition, including dispatch retry wait. Manual dispatch excluded. No samples when no schedules fire.

panels.title: Environment operation publications
panels.description: Committed current-claim results only. pending polls are not failures; certainty preserves unknown external effects.

panels.title: Renewals and retained execution endings
panels.description: Retained tools are separate from Attempt slots. limited/stopped renewals can be expected provider outcomes; lost executions need diagnosis.

panels.title: Checkpoint latency p95
panels.description: Successful checkpoint persistence latency. Failed writes appear in Run outcomes/logs, not successful checkpoint latency.

panels.title: Run object size p95
panels.description: Size of written run objects, not total retained storage.

panels.title: Outbox settled outcomes
panels.description: Committed delivery attempts. retry/deferred return to pending; dead requires operator attention.

panels.title: Retained dead deliveries
panels.description: Boolean retained dead state, filtered by snapshot freshness. Unlike increase(dead), retained faults remain visible until purged/reconciled.

panels.title: Outbox settlement failures
panels.description: Handler failure could not be settled. The claim retries after lease expiry; inspect Outbox settlement failed logs.

panels.title: Sweep pass outcomes
panels.description: succeeded only means the outer scan returned normally. Item faults are shown separately.

panels.title: Isolated item outcomes
panels.description: Counts isolated advancement, expiry, environment/browser maintenance and browser/desktop control calls. sweep identifies the owning workflow; advance_threads includes post-seal and delivery fast paths. succeeded may be a lock-race no-op; not a durable work count.

panels.title: Sweep completion gap / allowance
panels.description: Per-reporter age divided by 3 × (interval + deadline). Startup grants one allowance. Above 1 means no normally completed scan for too long.

panels.title: Realtime Worker slots
panels.description: Free and busy realtime slots across Workers. This pool is independent of ordinary attempts.

panels.title: Active realtime connections
panels.description: Open Control signaling WebSockets for both audio transports, including handshakes.

panels.title: Realtime handshake duration p95
panels.description: WebSocket accept to ready for successful handshakes, by audio transport.

panels.title: Realtime handshake outcomes
panels.description: Rates by audio transport and outcome. Requests denied before WebSocket accept are excluded.

panels.title: Realtime call endings
panels.description: Control signaling end reasons by audio transport. A connection outcome is separate from a committed Run status.

panels.title: Realtime relay discontinuities and overflows
panels.description: PCM gaps can recover; a control gap or overflow ends the call.

panels.title: Realtime orphan hangup attempts
panels.description: Cleanup outcomes for orphaned provider WebRTC calls, including retries.
